description.zh: 语言环境，默认为中文 zh | en。
description.en: The language. Valid values: zh and en. Default value: zh.
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Default value: false.

description.zh: 安装后的插件名称，如果不指定则生成默认规则名称。
description.en: The name of the add-on after it is installed. If you do not specify this parameter, a default rule name is generated.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms install-addon --name mysql --addon-version 0.0.1 --aliyun-lang zh --environment-id env-xxx --values host_:_mysql-service.default_,_port_:3306,_username_:_root_,_password_:_roots --release-name mysql-xxxxx --dry-run false --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms InstallAddon --region cn-hangzhou --EnvironmentId 'env-xxx' --AddonVersion '0.0.1' --Values 'host_:_mysql-service.default_,_port_:3306,_username_:_root_,_password_:_roots' --DryRun false --AliyunLang zh --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ReleaseName 'mysql-xxxxx' --Name mysql
